friction_discrepancy_forensics.explanation: The 1-cent variance arises purely from intermediate component rounding vs unrounded aggregate accumulation.
friction_discrepancy_forensics.canonical_verdict: Both representations are mathematically exact within their documented conventions. For ledger cash tracking, component-rounded transaction fees (25.58 USDT) represent the actual cash deductions posted by exchanges.

static_subsampling_evaluation.causal_defect: Static subsampling extracted arbitrary trades out of chronological sequence without modeling position-state continuity or portfolio equity path.

dynamic_chronological_simulation.method: Strict forward sequential cash execution with position sizing Q_t = 0.98 * Cash_t / P_t
dynamic_chronological_simulation.causal_validity: PASSED: In a downward trending asset (-22.95% to -25.61%), eliminating any subset of trades preserves capital by reducing market exposure and avoiding transaction friction. The session-aware filter provides no statistically significant timing alpha beyond trade frequency reduction.
